what_it_is.prose: Infosys Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered Indian multinational IT services and consulting company founded in 1981 by N. R. Narayana Murthy and six co-founders. Infosys's Aerospace and Defense consulting practice provides digital transformation, engineering services, cybersecurity and product lifecycle management solutions to global A&D OEMs and government customers. Key partnerships: (1) Rolls-Royce — strategic partnership for sourcing engineering and R&D services for Rolls-Royce's Civil Aerospace business (announced 2 December 2020); transition of significant portion of Rolls-Royce's Bengaluru captive center; (2) Rolls-Royce + Infosys launched joint 'Aerospace Engineering and Digital Innovation Centre' in India (8 April 2022); (3) Infosys Cobalt — cloud-based digital platform adopted by a leading aerostructure manufacturer. Infosys supports Indian defence customers with mission-critical IT systems including ERP, supply chain, MRO and lifecycle management.
